title: A day of Pokémon cards and Nintendo, Tokyo
h1: A day of Pokémon cards and Nintendo
lead: Three ways to spend one day around cards and Nintendo. Pick a plan to see the stops, the route and the official shop pages.
facts: 10:45 at Akihabara Station, Electric Town Exit
subject: Plan choice
meet_text: We meet at the Electric Town Exit of Akihabara Station at 10:45.
meet_hint: If another place or time is easier, tell your guide and the plan will be adjusted.
footer: Reply with the letter of the plan you want. Times are approximate and can move on the day. Opening hours come from each shop's official page and can change, so your guide checks them again before the day.
og_desc: Three one-day routes for Pokémon card collectors and Nintendo fans: Akihabara card shops, Shibuya Nintendo TOKYO, and the big Pokémon Centers.
